# LocalPDF

LocalPDF is a private PDF editor that runs entirely in your browser. 
No uploads, no server storage — all processing happens locally via WebAssembly.

## Pages

- [Home](https://localpdf.online/) — Private PDF Editor — Edit, Merge & OCR in Browser
- [Edit PDF](https://localpdf.online/features/edit-pdf) — Add text, edit pages, sign, watermark PDFs
- [Merge PDF](https://localpdf.online/features/merge-pdf) — Combine multiple PDF files
- [Compress PDF](https://localpdf.online/features/compress-pdf) — Reduce PDF file size
- [OCR PDF](https://localpdf.online/features/ocr-pdf) — Extract text from scanned PDFs
- [Split PDF](https://localpdf.online/features/split-pdf) — Split and extract PDF pages
- [Convert PDF](https://localpdf.online/features/convert-pdf) — Convert PDF to images, Word, Excel
- [Sign PDF](https://localpdf.online/features/sign-pdf) — Add digital signatures
- [Pricing](https://localpdf.online/pricing) — Free & Pro plans
- [Blog](https://localpdf.online/blog) — PDF guides and how-tos
- [Security](https://localpdf.online/security) — Local processing architecture
- [FAQ](https://localpdf.online/faq) — Frequently asked questions
